card.name: Linking words before material names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, with, from, for, and) right where a material or substance name is expected next, in text about manufacturing, composites and construction.

modes.label: Made from / with
modes.description: Prepositions after made, reinforced or produced, where a material is about to be named.

modes.label: Other links in materials text
modes.description: Words like and, for, was, low in engineering or concrete descriptions.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning material or materials, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence about making things where the material is about to be named.
